name: frontend_client_error
description: Alerts on repeated frontend JS or UI crashes

query_condition.sql: SELECT count(*) as total, frontend_component, frontend_route, min(client_user_id) as affected_user FROM "default" WHERE service_name IN ('scribe-backend', 'scribe_backend') AND event_type = 'frontend_client_error' AND severity IN ('error', 'fatal') GROUP BY frontend_component, frontend_route HAVING count(*) > 3
